ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a large triangle, with the base approximately horizontal, the left base angle labeled 70°, and the right base angle labeled 40°. A line segment is drawn from the vertex toward the interior of the base, dividing the vertex angle into two parts: the left part is labeled angle 2, and the right part is labeled 45°. Reasoning: The sum of the three interior angles of the entire large triangle is 180°, so the total vertex angle of the large triangle is 180° - 70° - 40° = 70°. The vertex angle is divided into angle 2 and 45°, therefore angle 2 = 70° - 45° = 25°.
